findings.description: Critical: range audits reserve `openspec/choices/<run-id>/` before evidence collection or document validation, so any later internal error returns `ok=False` but leaves an empty run directory behind. That directory is a fourth side effect outside D6's closed write set and `list_active_runs` will count it as a run even though no ledger pair was written.
findings.resolution: Move the atomic reservation as late as possible, just before writing the ledger pair, and clean up the reserved directory on any failure before `choices.json` is written; add a range-form internal-error test that asserts no run directory remains.

findings.description: Critical: change-id audits now resolve `generated_at` and `git_sha` before `collect_evidence()`, while main resolved them after evidence processing immediately before writing. For ordinary change-id runs without explicit `now`/`git_sha`, a slow evidence pass or moving HEAD can produce different header bytes, violating the stated byte-for-byte unchanged contract for the change-id form.
findings.resolution: Branch the routing: for non-range change ids keep the old order and resolve `now`/`git_sha` after evidence processing; only range audits need those values early to reserve the dated output directory.

findings.description: Nit: the D6 SKILL.md assertions only check for `openspec/choices/` and `openspec/choices/archive/`. They would still pass if the Read-Only Contract, Red Flags, or Output section stopped naming `latest.json` and `latest.md`, even though scenarios 12 and 15 require those latest pointers explicitly.
findings.resolution: Assert the exact required destination tokens in each relevant section: `choices.json`, `choices.md`, `latest.json`, `latest.md`, and `openspec/choices/archive/`.
